name: Cyrus the Poet
bio: Cyrus the Poet is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to 6th century AD. Paton's index lists the poet among the writers of the Cycle of Agathias, compiled in the sixth century AD.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 557).

poems.title: Book VII, 557
poems.author: Cyrus the Poet
poems.text: Mara had passed her thirtieth year and was approaching her thirty-third, when Hades cast at her his cruel dart and carried off the woman who was like a rosebud, a very counterpart of Penelope in her work.
